failures.cause: Replacing `@validator('cache_reason', always=True)` with `@field_validator('cache_reason')` means the validator no longer runs when `cache_reason` is omitted and defaults to None, so `cached=True` without an explicit `cache_reason` passes validation.
failures.fix: Move the cached/cache_reason rule to a `@model_validator(mode='after')` (or otherwise restore always-on cross-field validation) so constructing with `cached=True` and no `cache_reason` still raises the same ValidationError.
